get.summary:
`GET /files/whiteboard/items/{item_id}/files/{file_id}`: the bytes, for
anyone who may currently see the board.
get.description: Use the authenticated frame file gateway. Rechecks current board access before streaming an available image, up to 10 MiB.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: Board file row ID returned as id by the reservation

Content-Length.description: Size of the response in bytes

X-Miy-File-Sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the stored file

401.description: Platform identity could not be verified

404.description: The board or image is missing or is not visible

503.description: The image could not be read or a required platform service is unavailable

put.summary:
`PUT /files/whiteboard/items/{item_id}/files/{file_id}`: the uploader
streams the reserved bytes while they may still edit the board. A repeat
after a lost answer reports the stored state.
put.description: Use the authenticated frame file gateway. Send the exact number of reserved bytes, up to 10 MiB. Only the person who reserved the file may upload it, while they can edit the board.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: Board file row ID returned as id by the reservation

401.description: Platform identity could not be verified

403.description: The caller cannot edit this board

404.description: The board or image is missing or is not available to the caller

503.description: The image could not be stored or a required platform service is unavailable

patch.summary:
`PATCH …/items/{item_id}`: AI-DO `update_whiteboard_item`
(item_mutations.py). A scene save carries `base_revision`, the revision
the editor loaded or last saved. A changed scene from an older revision is
refused with 409 instead of overwriting (AI-DO merged concurrent editors
with Yjs). A scene equal to the stored one (ignoring per-viewer editor
state) changes nothing, whatever its revision.
patch.description: The JSON request is limited to 4 MiB. Scene saves require base_revision and use 409 for conflicting newer changes.

caller, at most 30.

parameters.description: Filter workspace members by name. The trimmed query may contain up to 200 characters.

BinaryBody.description: Bodies streamed through the file gateway.

scene.description: Excalidraw scene object. Omit or send null to start with an empty scene.
Excalidraw scene object. `files` references stored images by row ID.

id.description: Board file row ID to save as `storage` in the scene.

revision.description: Stored scene revision used for concurrent saves.

mime.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP. The server trims and lowercases this value.

name.description: The trimmed filename may contain up to 255 characters and no control characters.

size.description: Exact size in bytes, up to 10 MiB.

limit.description: Defaults to 5. Supplied values are clamped to the range 1 to 10.

query.description: A trimmed query of 1 to 200 characters returns eligible matches.

ShareableUser.description:
AI-DO `ShareableUserItem`; `email` is empty (the directory has none) and
`primary_group` names the person's group.

SharingResponse.description:
AI-DO `WhiteboardSharingResponse`. Link shares are not offered in miy, so
`link_share` is always null.

name.description: The space name must contain a non-whitespace character.

app.description: Use `whiteboard` for a board shared in its own workspace.

id.description: The board's space ID, or `global` for the app-wide space.

type.description: Use `workspace_sidebar` for a board shared in its own workspace.

base_revision.description: Integer scene revision. Required when `scene` is present, including null.

scene.description: Omit to leave the scene unchanged. An explicit null clears it.

title.description: Omit or send null to leave the title unchanged.
